dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.connectedLead: Google Tasks is connected. Open Tasks for Today, Inbox, your lists, filters, board view, and keyboard shortcuts (?).
dashboard.disconnectedLead: Connect Google once to load your lists. Edits you make here stay in sync with Google Tasks.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: These shortcuts work on the Tasks page when focus is not in a text field. With task details open, Enter saves from single-line fields; Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter saves from notes. Press Escape to close this dialog.
shortcuts.actionCommandPalette: Open command palette (navigate, search, quick add)
shortcuts.actionList: Go to list view (current or first list)
shortcuts.actionInspect: Open details for highlighted task (list view)
shortcuts.actionDblClick: Open details (row or card, outside buttons)
shortcuts.actionDetailSave: Save task details (list, title, due, recurrence, priority fields)
shortcuts.actionDetailNotesSave: Save from notes (plain Enter adds a newline)
shortcuts.conflictsNote: Navigation shortcuts (g then t, etc.) are skipped while focus is in a field; Enter in the task edit panel saves (see rows above). Ctrl+K / ⌘K opens the command palette; “/” focuses search. Some browsers reserve keys — use the palette if a binding conflicts.

tasks.connectSubhead: Sign in once to load your lists. Task content lives in Google; this app syncs through your account and may keep server data needed for sign-in and optional features (see Profile).
tasks.connectBullet1: Use Today, Inbox, per-list views, priorities, search, filters, and bulk actions.
tasks.connectBullet2: We only request Google Tasks access; disconnect anytime in Profile.
tasks.staleGoogleConnectionHint: This tab still thought Google was connected, but the server refused access (for example you disconnected in another tab). Refresh the page, then connect again if needed.
tasks.helpBullet1: Today shows incomplete tasks that have a due date on or before the end of today ({tz}). Overdue tasks stay here until you complete them or change the due date.
tasks.helpBullet2: Inbox is the default Google list: we use the list titled “My Tasks” when it exists; otherwise the first list Google returns. Every task still lives in a real Google list.
tasks.helpBullet3: New tasks from Today, Inbox, or All lists are created in that default list.
tasks.helpBulletAll: All lists merges every task from every Google list in one view; the chip on each row is its home list. Use the list filter to focus on one list without leaving this view.
tasks.helpBulletBulk: Bulk: use the first checkbox on each row, or Ctrl/Cmd+click to toggle and Shift+click for a range. On narrow screens, use the checkboxes — there is no touch multi-select gesture.
tasks.helpBulletFilters: Filters and board view apply on top of the current navigation (Today / Inbox / list). Board columns are P1–P4 by priority; drag a card to another column to change priority, or use Details to edit priority and more.

errors.rateLimited: Google rate limited (429). Polling slowed; try again shortly.
errors.chooseDest: Choose a destination (lists must load) and enter a title.

codes.auth_expired: Google access expired. Reconnect Google in Profile.
codes.rate_limit: Google rate limited this request. Try again shortly.
codes.server_error: Google Tasks is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
codes.network: Could not reach Google. Check your connection.
codes.bad_request: This action could not be completed.
codes.not_found: That task or list was not found.
codes.generic: Something went wrong with Google Tasks.

tasks.notesPlaceholder: Links (https://…) are clickable after save. Paste a URL here to append it quickly.
tasks.allListsRow: Every task, every list — use filters to narrow

sort.label: Task order
sort.hintLists: Applies to all lists. Search ranking is unchanged.
sort.hintKanban: Applies to all views. Column order may differ from Google.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Tasks
onboarding.lead: A quick tour of what you can do here:
onboarding.bulletToday: Today shows tasks due today and overdue. Use Inbox and Lists for everything else.
onboarding.bulletSearch: Search defaults to keywords; switch to semantic when you want meaning-based matching.
onboarding.bulletPalette: Press ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl+K to open the command palette — navigate, search, and quick add.
onboarding.bulletSwipe: On your phone, swipe a task row for quick actions. Undo appears for destructive steps.
onboarding.bulletSort: Task order (Due first or Priority first) is shared across all lists and the board.

tasks.emptyTodayBody: Tasks without a due date appear in Inbox or a list — not here. Switch navigation to find them.
tasks.emptyInboxBody: Add a task with the field above; it syncs to your default Google list.
tasks.emptyListBody: When this list has tasks in Google, they show up here automatically.
tasks.emptyAllBody: When Google Tasks has items in any list, they appear here. Try Inbox or a specific list, or add a task above (it goes to your default list).
tasks.footer: Google Tasks is the source of truth.
tasks.searchTruncated: Showing first matches only — refine your query.
tasks.searchIndexEmpty: Semantic index is empty. Build it once to search by meaning.
tasks.bulkSelectTask: Select for bulk actions (complete, move, or delete several tasks)
tasks.checkboxRowHint: Each row: first checkbox selects tasks for the bulk toolbar above; second checkbox marks the task done (or not done) in Google Tasks.
tasks.bulkDeleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete {count} task(s) from Google Tasks.
tasks.noFilterMatchBody: Try adjusting or resetting filters to see more tasks.
tasks.kanbanHint: Columns are P1–P4 (decoded from task titles). Drag a card to another column to change priority.

defer.summaryTooltip: Tomorrow: next calendar day (9:00 if the task had no due; otherwise same clock time). Next week: Monday 00:00 at the start of the ISO week after this one. Weekend: next Saturday 09:00 local (today at 09:00 if it is Saturday morning).

swipe.rowHint: Swipe right on a row to complete, or left for more actions. Long-press a row to open the same menu. Wider screens and mouse/trackpad keep the row buttons.

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.footerHint: Arrow keys and Enter to run. Escape to close.
commandPalette.quickAddHint: Uses the same target list as the new-task row (Add to list / view default).

profile.disconnectGoogleDescription: Disconnect to remove stored Google tokens, clear the cached access token, and delete your semantic search index rows on this server. Your Google account and tasks are unchanged.
profile.disconnectGoogleConfirmBody: Enter your account password to confirm. This removes OAuth tokens and semantic index data from this app.
profile.disconnectGoogleSuccess: Google has been disconnected and local index data removed.
profile.syncIntro: The Tasks page refreshes from Google on a timer. Values below are configured on the server.
profile.syncNote429: After a Google rate limit (HTTP 429), refreshes slow down up to the maximum backoff, then ease back to the target interval when requests succeed again.
profile.undoToastIntro: After you complete, move, or delete a task, you may undo for a short time. For deletes, the app waits before removing the task on Google so you can bring it back — choose how long that window lasts. Other actions use the same timer for the toast.
